recognize_zh: 大型巨噬細胞的淡藍泡沫狀細胞質中，同時可見被吞噬的紅血球、一個小而深染的核碎片/細胞殘骸以及多顆深色顆粒狀碎屑，是典型的噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular cell border
Single round-to-oval nucleus with fine chromatin, eccentrically placed
Phagocytosed red cells (pale pink round inclusions) within the cytoplasm
Engulfed nucleated cell/nuclear debris (dense purple round body) and scattered dark granular cellular debris
Background of clumped red cells in a marrow aspirate smear
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant, pale, vacuolated cytoplasm and an eccentric oval nucleus with fine chromatin. The cytoplasm contains phagocytosed erythrocytes, a dense purple round body representing an engulfed nucleated cell or nuclear remnant, and multiple small dark fragments of cellular debris. Findings represent hemophagocytosis, which in the appropriate clinical and laboratory setting supports a diagnosis of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis shows intact viable cells within a large multilobated megakaryocyte, not a mononuclear macrophage with degraded red cells and nuclear debris.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear fragments without engulfed red cells or platelets.
Storage histiocytes contain blue-green granules or striated/foamy lipid material rather than recognizable engulfed red cells and nucleated cells.
Siderophages contain coarse blue-black hemosiderin granules (Prussian blue positive) rather than intact red cells.
